title: Research Posters
slide_intent: Teach researchers to edit a poster for reading at a distance. A colleague needs an entry point, a route through the findings and figures they can interpret.
strategic_value: CSAIL can give different research groups a recognizable presentation format while allowing their scientific content to determine the illustrations.
demonstration: A compact checklist sits alongside a wide poster. The poster uses a title band and six content panels with charts, type examples and a diagram.
practical_value: Choose the main message first, then test the size of the text, the order of the panels and the clarity of every figure from the intended viewing distance.

content_islands.name: Poster checklist
content_islands.spec: Use the left column for concise guidance on the title, text volume, color, viewing distance and figures.

content_islands.name: Title band
content_islands.spec: Place the sample headline and institutional marks above the poster body.

content_islands.name: Six-panel body
content_islands.spec: Arrange two rows of three content groups. Contrast figures, large numbers and text so each group has a clear first read.
